test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 16 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In December 2021 to improve the leadership skills of grassroot women political leaders, which of the following organisations launched a pan-India capacity building programme called ‘She is a Changemaker’ for women representatives at all levels?
solution:
The correct answer is __**National Commission for Women**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points**__

 
• **National Commission for Women** was formed in 1992 under the **National Commission for Women Act 1990** (Act No. 20).
 
• **1st chairperson** of the National Commission for Women was **Mrs. Jayanti Pattnaik**
 
• the current chairperson is **Mrs. Rekha Sharma,** who took charge on 07.08.2018
